text: {who} arrives eleven minutes late, carrying a laptop and an explanation.
{who} says "as I was saying" before making a point that somebody else made first.
{who} has stayed up all night on a slide deck that nobody asked for.
{who} stops to ask how your week has been, and seems to listen to the answer.
{who} challenges a figure on the slide, and turns out to be right.
{who} asks, some way in, which meeting this is.
{who} writes something down whenever a senior name is mentioned, and only then.
{who} volunteers for the action that nobody wants, and looks tired doing it.
{who} mentions, in passing, that the delay began in another team.
{who} says nothing for the whole meeting, and is the first to leave.
